title: Entry: the NBA tab
note: The NBA tab with its new section row; the Grizzlies chip is focused. The hero stays at y 128; the day chips move under it.

title: Entry: hold OK on a game card
note: Hold OK on any game card: both team pages are one press away.

title: Standings: top
note: West first (your conference). Rows 1 to 9 whole, the scroll bar says there is more.

title: Standings: your row focused
note: Inset ring on the Grizzlies row (team bar, surface-1 highlight). OK opens the team page.

title: Standings: scrolled
note: Past the last visible row the bar and the chips slide away; the column names stay at y 52.

title: Standings: shield on
note: Shield on, the Kings game unseen: the West is shown as it was before it, and says so.

title: Leaders: points
note: Category column (focus switches after 250 ms), the leader on their team plate, 2 to 10 below.

title: Leaders: a row focused
note: Rebounds, Cameron Boozer (your team) focused. OK opens his team page on his roster row.

title: Team stats: assists
note: The column shows your team's rank in each; the list scrolls so your team is in view (19th).

title: News: list and preview
note: Headlines on the left, the focused story's photo, headline and summary on the right.

title: News: shield on
note: Stories about a Grizzlies result you haven't seen are covered: no photo, no headline.

title: News: the article sheet
note: OK on a story: a reading sheet with the full text from ESPN. ▲▼ scroll it, Back closes.

title: Team: top
note: Your team: plate, record and seed, the next game with Remind me (focused), the schedule rail.

title: Team: schedule rail
note: Left from the next game: results. The focused tile stays in the third slot while there is more.

title: Team: ranks and news
note: Down from the schedule: the page slides up, the bar steps away. Rank tiles, then the team's news, then the roster.

title: Team: shield on, news
note: Shield on: ranks hidden, stories about the unseen game covered (no photo, no headline), PTS and FG% hidden.

title: Team: roster scrolled
note: Roster with season averages; column names stay at y 92; long names and players who haven't played.

title: Team: player sheet
note: OK on a roster row: the player's card. Its one button jumps to the leaders list he is in.

title: Team: shield on
note: Shield on, the Kings game unseen: record as of before it, the tile and the ranks hidden.

title: Team: another team
note: Any team (from standings, leaders, game cards): the same page in its colours, with Make my team.

title: State: ESPN down
note: ESPN not answering: the last copy stays on screen with its time; Try again is the one thing to do.

title: State: loading
note: First visit, nothing cached: flat blocks in the final layout, focus stays on the chip.
